ir.intuition: Selects per instance the single highest positive preference pair by clamped log probability differences, using vectorized torch ops with an upper-triangular mask and topk, returning PrefBatch.pair_idx as a tuple of tensors (batch_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx) for valid pairwise preferences.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    logp = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # shape: (batch_size, n)
    batch_size, n = logp.shape

    # Compute pairwise score differences: (batch_size, n, n)
    score_diff = logp[:, :, None] - logp[:, None, :]

    # Clamp differences
    combined_input = score_diff.clamp(-20, 20)

    # Create upper triangular mask without loops (shape: n, n)
    mask_upper = torch.triu(torch.ones(n, n, dtype=torch.bool, device=logp.device), diagonal=1)

    # Expand mask to batch size
    mask_upper = mask_upper.unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, n, n)

    # Mask out lower triangle and diagonal by setting to -inf
    masked_scores = torch.where(mask_upper, combined_input, torch.full_like(combined_input, float('-inf')))

    # Mask pairs with non-positive difference
    positive_mask = masked_scores > 0
    masked_scores = torch.where(positive_mask, masked_scores, torch.full_like(masked_scores, float('-inf')))

    # Flatten pairs dimension for topk selection
    flat_scores = masked_scores.reshape(batch_size, -1)  # (batch_size, n*n)

    # Get top scoring pair index per batch
    top_values, top_indices = torch.topk(flat_scores, k=1, dim=1)
    top_indices = top_indices[:, 0]  # (batch_size,)

    # Convert flat indices back to pair indices
    winner = top_indices // n
    loser = top_indices % n

    # Create batch indices
    batch_indices = torch.arange(batch_size, dtype=torch.long, device=logp.device)

    # PrefBatch.pair_idx must be a tuple (b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    pair_idx = (batch_indices, winner, loser)

    pref_batch = PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=pair_idx,
        weight=None,
        meta={'description': 'Preference pairs based on positive clamped log_prob differences with vectorized upper-triangular mask'}
    )
    return pref_batch

ir.intuition: pair geometry via rank-band top-k pairing with exponential gap-based weighting
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    k = min(10, N-1)  # band width for pairing

    # Compute ranks per batch instance (argsort twice)
    sorted_idx = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)  # ascending order
    rank = torch.zeros_like(sorted_idx)
    rank.scatter_(1, sorted_idx, torch.arange(N, device=objective.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, N))

    # For each item, pair with top-k ranked better items within band
    pairs_b = []
    pairs_w = []
    pairs_l = []
    weights = []

    # Vectorized approach:
    # For each b, for each item i, find items j where rank[b,j] < rank[b,i] and rank[b,i] - rank[b,j] <= k
    # i.e. better items within rank band
    rank_i = rank.unsqueeze(2)  # (B,N,1)
    rank_j = rank.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,N)
    rank_diff = rank_i - rank_j  # (B,N,N)

    mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= k)

    # Also ensure objective values reflect better winner: objective[b,j] < objective[b,i]
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B,N,1)
    obj_j = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,N)
    better_mask = obj_j < obj_i

    final_mask = mask & better_mask

    b_idx, i_idx, j_idx = final_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # winners are j_idx, losers are i_idx
    # weight by exp(-rank_diff) to emphasize closer ranks
    rank_diff_vals = rank_diff[b_idx, i_idx, j_idx].float()
    weight_vals = torch.exp(-rank_diff_vals)

    # Limit total pairs to max_pairs by top weights
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weight_vals, max_pairs)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        i_idx = i_idx[topk_idx]
        j_idx = j_idx[topk_idx]
        weight_vals = topk_vals

    # Return PrefBatch with pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight_vals
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, j_idx, i_idx), weight=weight_vals, meta={'builder': 'topk_rankband'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    batch_size, n = objective.shape
    max_band = int(extra.get('max_band', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    # Compute pairwise diff and rank indices
    diff = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]
    # Identify pairs where winner beats loser
    mask = diff > 0
    # For each winner, get top max_band closest losers by rank distance
    idxs = torch.arange(n, device=objective.device)
    idxs_w = idxs[None, :, None]  # shape (1,n,1)
    idxs_l = idxs[None, None, :]  # shape (1,1,n)
    rank_diff = torch.abs(idxs_w - idxs_l)  # shape (1,n,n)
    rank_diff = rank_diff.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
    band_mask = rank_diff <= max_band
    final_mask = mask & band_mask
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = final_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # Limit total pairs
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        pair_gaps = diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
        # Weight with exponential decay by gap magnitude
        weights = torch.exp(-pair_gaps.abs())
        keep = torch.topk(weights, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[keep]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[keep]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[keep]
        weights = weights[keep]
    else:
        weights = torch.exp(-diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].abs())
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_sparse', 'max_band': max_band, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

        winner_idx = torch.cat([winner_idx_gap, winner_idx_all[indices]])
        loser_idx = torch.cat([loser_idx_gap, loser_idx_all[indices]])
    else:

        topk = torch.topk(gap[b_idx_gap, winner_idx_gap, loser_idx_gap], k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    batch_size, n = objective.shape
    rank = objective.argsort(dim=1, descending=False)  # ascending order: lower_is_better

    # Compute rank positions for each item
    inv_rank = torch.zeros_like(rank)
    inv_rank.scatter_(1, rank, torch.arange(n, device=objective.device).expand(batch_size, n))

    band_width = int(extra.get('rank_band_width', 5))

    # For each instance, create pair mask for pairs within band_width in rank
    inv_rank_i = inv_rank.unsqueeze(2)  # shape (B, N, 1)
    inv_rank_j = inv_rank.unsqueeze(1)  # shape (B, 1, N)

    rank_diff = (inv_rank_i - inv_rank_j).abs()
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)

    # Only consider pairs where objective[i] < objective[j] (winner better)
    better_mask = (objective.unsqueeze(2) < objective.unsqueeze(1))

    pair_mask = band_mask & better_mask

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = pair_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute gap for weighting
    gap = (objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx])

    # Weight: logistic capped at max 1.0, scaled gap
    scale = float(extra.get('weight_scale', 2.0))
    raw_weight = torch.sigmoid(gap * scale)
    weight = torch.clamp(raw_weight, max=1.0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_sparse', 'band_width': band_width, 'weight_scale': scale})

    # Form all pairs where objective_w < objective_l

    # Compute score difference for pairs if available, else use objective difference

    else:

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    batch_size, n = objective.shape
    max_band = int(extra.get('max_band', 4))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('min_gap', 0.1))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    idxs = torch.arange(n, device=objective.device)
    anchors = idxs.unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, n)  # shape (batch_size, n)

    # For each anchor, consider only items with strictly higher rank (larger idx) within max_band
    higher_rank_mask = (idxs.unsqueeze(0) > idxs.unsqueeze(1)) & (idxs.unsqueeze(0) - idxs.unsqueeze(1) <= max_band)
    higher_rank_mask = higher_rank_mask.to(objective.device)  # shape (n, n)
    higher_rank_mask = higher_rank_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, -1, -1)  # (batch_size, n, n)

    # Compute pairwise gaps: objective_loser - objective_winner for candidate pairs
    gap = objective[:, :, None] - objective[:, None, :]  # shape (batch_size, n, n)

    # Winner is anchor (idx i), loser is j with higher rank (j > i)
    # So mask pairs where j > i and gap_j_i > min_gap
    candidate_mask = higher_rank_mask & (gap < -min_gap)  # gap < -min_gap means objective[j] - objective[i] > min_gap

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = candidate_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute weights as exponential decay of gap magnitude (positive values)
    gaps_selected = (objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]).clamp(min=0)
    weights = torch.exp(-gaps_selected)

    # Cap total pairs by max_pairs, keep top weighted pairs
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        keep_idx = torch.topk(weights, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[keep_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[keep_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[keep_idx]
        weights = weights[keep_idx]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_band_gap_expweight', 'max_band': max_band, 'min_gap': min_gap, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (batch, n)
    batch_size, n = objective.shape
    max_band = int(extra.get('rank_band_width', 5))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('min_gap', 0.05))

    # Compute ranks per batch by sorting objective ascending (lower is better)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1)

    # Create a zero tensor for inverse ranks: ranks_inv[b, idx] = rank position
    ranks_inv = torch.zeros_like(ranks)
    batch_idx = torch.arange(batch_size, device=objective.device)[:, None]
    ranks_inv[batch_idx, ranks] = torch.arange(n, device=objective.device)[None, :]

    # For each anchor idx, consider only items with rank position within max_band above anchor
    # i.e. pairs where winner_rank - loser_rank in [1, max_band]

    # Create pairwise rank difference matrix
    rank_w = ranks_inv[:, :, None]  # (batch, n, 1)
    rank_l = ranks_inv[:, None, :]  # (batch, 1, n)
    rank_diff = rank_l - rank_w  # positive means loser ranked worse (higher)

    # Mask pairs where rank_diff in [1, max_band]
    band_mask = (rank_diff >= 1) & (rank_diff <= max_band)

    # Also enforce objective gap >= min_gap
    obj_w = objective[:, :, None]
    obj_l = objective[:, None, :]
    gap = obj_l - obj_w  # positive if loser objective > winner objective
    gap_mask = gap >= min_gap

    valid_mask = band_mask & gap_mask

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute inverse rank distance weight: higher weight for closer ranks
    dist = rank_diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].float()
    weight = 1.0 / dist

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=weight,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_band_anchor_gap',
            'rank_band_width': max_band,
            'min_gap': min_gap
        }
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_band = int(extra.get('max_band', 3))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.1))

    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)
    # Anchor index (winner)
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :]  # (1, N)
    # Loser indices in a band ahead of winner (winner < loser <= winner + max_band)
    loser_range = winner_idx + torch.arange(1, max_band + 1, device=objective.device).view(-1, 1)  # (max_band, N)
    loser_range = loser_range.clamp(max=N-1)

    # Broadcast batch dim
    winner_idx = winner_idx.expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    loser_range = loser_range.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Gather objective values
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx)  # (B, N)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_range.view(B, -1))  # (B, max_band*N)

    # Reshape to (B, max_band, N)
    obj_l = obj_l.view(B, max_band, N)

    # Condition: winner objective < loser objective, and gap >= min_gap
    mask = (obj_w.unsqueeze(1) < obj_l) & ((obj_l - obj_w.unsqueeze(1)) >= min_gap)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Get valid pairs indices
    b_idx, band_idx, w_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # winner_idx and loser_idx
    winner_idx_final = w_idx
    loser_idx_final = loser_range[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]

    # Compute gap and weight as exponential decay of gap
    gap = obj_l[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx] - obj_w[b_idx, w_idx]
    weights = torch.exp(-gap)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx_final, loser_idx_final), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_expdecay_gapweight', 'max_band': max_band, 'gap_threshold': min_gap})

    gap = objective[b_idx_all, loser_idx_all] - objective[b_idx_all, winner_idx_all]

    valid_tie_mask = gap >= tie_zone

        remaining = max_pairs - total_pairs
        tie_rest_mask = ~mask_gap
        b_idx_rest = b_idx_all[tie_rest_mask]
        winner_idx_rest = winner_idx_all[tie_rest_mask]

        winner_idx_fill = winner_idx_rest[:fill_count]

    obj_diff = objective[b_idx_all, loser_idx_all] - objective[b_idx_all, winner_idx_all]

    winner_idx = winner_idx_all[valid_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx_all[valid_mask]
    filtered_obj_diff = obj_diff[valid_mask]

    weights_raw = filtered_obj_diff.clamp(min=0)

    weight_sums = weights_raw.new_zeros(B)

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (batch, n)
    batch_size, n = objective.shape
    max_band = int(extra.get('rank_band_width', 5))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('min_gap', 0.05))
    weight_cap = float(extra.get('weight_cap', 5.0))

    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1)
    ranks_inv = torch.zeros_like(ranks)
    batch_idx = torch.arange(batch_size, device=objective.device)[:, None]
    ranks_inv[batch_idx, ranks] = torch.arange(n, device=objective.device)[None, :]

    rank_w = ranks_inv[:, :, None]  # (batch, n, 1)
    rank_l = ranks_inv[:, None, :]  # (batch, 1, n)
    rank_diff = rank_l - rank_w  # positive means loser ranked worse (higher)

    obj_l = objective[:, None, :]
    gap = obj_l - obj_w
    gap_mask = gap >= min_gap

    valid_mask = band_mask & gap_mask

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    dist = rank_diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].float()
    weight = 1.0 / dist

    # Explicit clamp to enforce constraint on weights
    weight = weight.clamp(max=weight_cap)

    return PrefBatch(

        weight=weight,
        meta={

            'rank_band_width': max_band,
            'min_gap': min_gap,

        }
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    logp = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = logp.shape
    topk = int(extra.get('topk', 32))

    diff = logp[:, :, None] - logp[:, None, :]  # (B, N, N)
    mask_pos = diff > 0
    diag_mask = ~torch.eye(N, device=logp.device, dtype=torch.bool).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)
    valid_mask = mask_pos & diag_mask

    scores = diff.masked_fill(~valid_mask, float('-inf'))  # (B, N, N)
    scores_flat = scores.view(B, -1)  # (B, N*N)

    topk_values, topk_indices = torch.topk(scores_flat, k=topk, dim=1)
    valid_topk_mask = topk_values > float('-inf')

    batch_idx = torch.arange(B, device=logp.device).unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, topk)[valid_topk_mask].to(torch.int64)
    pair_idx = topk_indices[valid_topk_mask].to(torch.int64)
    winner_idx = pair_idx // N
    loser_idx = pair_idx % N

    pair_idx = (batch_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=pair_idx,
        weight=None,
        meta={'description': 'Top-k positive log_prob difference pairs globally per batch using vectorized ops, with required family tags'}
    )

ir.intuition: Pairs are constructed by anchoring winners and selecting losers from a sparse set of indices with maximal disagreement in log_prob ranking, weighted by the objective gap for focused learning on contentious pairs.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_candidates = int(extra.get('max_candidates', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.1))

    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)
    # Anchor winners: all indices
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :].expand(B, N)  # (B, N)

    # Compute pairwise disagreement as abs difference of log_prob ranks
    # Get ranks by sorting log_prob descending
    _, ranks = log_prob.argsort(dim=1, descending=True).sort(dim=1)  # ranks: (B, N), lower rank means better

    # Expand ranks for broadcasting
    ranks_w = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    ranks_l = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    rank_disagreement = torch.abs(ranks_w - ranks_l)  # (B, N, N)

    # For each winner, select top max_candidates losers with largest disagreement
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(rank_disagreement, k=max_candidates, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B, N, max_candidates)

    # Gather objective for winner and losers
    obj_w = objective.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, max_candidates)  # (B, N, max_candidates)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, topk_idx.view(B, -1)).view(B, N, max_candidates)  # (B, N, max_candidates)

    # Condition winner objective < loser objective and gap >= min_gap
    valid_mask = (obj_w < obj_l) & ((obj_l - obj_w) >= min_gap)  # (B, N, max_candidates)

    b_idx, w_idx, c_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, w_idx, c_idx]
    winner_idx_final = w_idx

    # Compute gap and weights as exponential decay of gap
    gap = obj_l[b_idx, w_idx, c_idx] - obj_w[b_idx, w_idx, c_idx]
    weights = torch.exp(-gap)

    # Cap total pairs to max_pairs by top weighted pairs
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        top_weights, top_indices = torch.topk(weights, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[top_indices]
        winner_idx_final = winner_idx_final[top_indices]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[top_indices]
        weights = top_weights

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx_final, loser_idx),
        weight=weights,
        meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_anchor_gapweight', 'max_candidates': max_candidates, 'gap_threshold': min_gap, 'max_pairs': max_pairs}
    )

ir.intuition: Pairs are formed by anchoring on winners and selecting losers in a sparse rank band ahead where model prediction disagreement is highest, weighted by normalized disagreement magnitude to emphasize informative uncertain pairs.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_band = int(extra.get('max_band', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    disagreement_threshold = float(extra.get('disagreement_threshold', 0.05))

    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)  # (N,)
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :]  # (1, N)
    # Loser indices in sparse band ahead: only every other index in band
    band_offsets = torch.arange(1, max_band + 1, 2, device=objective.device)  # (ceil(max_band/2),)
    loser_range = winner_idx + band_offsets.view(-1, 1)  # (num_offsets, N)
    loser_range = loser_range.clamp(max=N-1)  # prevent overflow

    # Broadcast batch dim
    winner_idx = winner_idx.expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    loser_range = loser_range.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, num_offsets, N)

    # Gather objective and log_prob values
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx)  # (B, N)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_range.view(B, -1)).view(B, loser_range.shape[1], N)  # (B, num_offsets, N)
    lp_w = log_prob.gather(1, winner_idx)  # (B, N)
    lp_l = log_prob.gather(1, loser_range.view(B, -1)).view(B, loser_range.shape[1], N)  # (B, num_offsets, N)

    # Condition: winner objective < loser objective
    valid_mask = obj_w.unsqueeze(1) < obj_l  # (B, num_offsets, N)

    # Compute disagreement as abs difference in log_prob predictions
    disagreement = (lp_w.unsqueeze(1) - lp_l).abs()  # (B, num_offsets, N)
    # Mask disagreement by valid pairs
    disagreement = disagreement * valid_mask.float()

    # Filter pairs with disagreement above threshold
    disc_mask = disagreement >= disagreement_threshold

    b_idx, band_idx, w_idx = disc_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        # fallback: return empty PrefBatch
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(torch.tensor([], device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long), torch.tensor([], device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long), torch.tensor([], device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_anchor_rankband'})

    winner_idx_final = w_idx
    loser_idx_final = loser_range[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]

    # Select top-k pairs by disagreement per batch
    pair_disagreement = disagreement[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]

    # Normalize weights by max disagreement in batch to [0,1], add eps to avoid div0
    max_disc = pair_disagreement.max()
    norm_weights = pair_disagreement / (max_disc + 1e-8)

    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_indices = torch.topk(norm_weights, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_indices]
        winner_idx_final = winner_idx_final[topk_indices]
        loser_idx_final = loser_idx_final[topk_indices]
        norm_weights = norm_weights[topk_indices]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx_final, loser_idx_final), weight=norm_weights, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_anchor_rankband', 'max_band': max_band, 'disagreement_threshold': disagreement_threshold, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

    valid_pairs = valid_pairs.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, N, N)

    obj_w = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    obj_l = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)

    # Strict winner objective < loser objective
    strict_mask = obj_w < obj_l  # (B, N, N)
    pair_mask = valid_pairs & strict_mask  # (B, N, N)

    b_idx_s, w_idx_s, l_idx_s = pair_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    strict_counts = torch.bincount(b_idx_s, minlength=B) if b_idx_s.numel() > 0 else torch.zeros(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
    no_strict_batches = (strict_counts == 0).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]

    if no_strict_batches.numel() > 0:
        equal_mask = valid_pairs & (obj_w == obj_l)  # (B, N, N)
        b_idx_e, w_idx_e, l_idx_e = equal_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

        batch_mask = torch.zeros(B, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device)
        batch_mask[no_strict_batches] = True
        keep_eq_mask = batch_mask[b_idx_e]

        b_idx_e = b_idx_e[keep_eq_mask]
        w_idx_e = w_idx_e[keep_eq_mask]
        l_idx_e = l_idx_e[keep_eq_mask]

        if b_idx_s.numel() > 0:
            b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx_s, b_idx_e], dim=0)
            w_idx = torch.cat([w_idx_s, w_idx_e], dim=0)
            l_idx = torch.cat([l_idx_s, l_idx_e], dim=0)
        else:
            b_idx, w_idx, l_idx = b_idx_e, w_idx_e, l_idx_e
    else:
        b_idx, w_idx, l_idx = b_idx_s, w_idx_s, l_idx_s

    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        if N > 1:
            b_idx = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.long, device=objective.device)
            w_idx = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.long, device=objective.device)
            l_idx = torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.long, device=objective.device)
        else:
            empty = torch.tensor([], dtype=torch.long, device=objective.device)
            return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'objective_order_pairs_strict_fixed_nonempty_v2_repaired_tagged', 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        keys = b_idx.to(torch.int64) * (N**2) + w_idx.to(torch.int64) * N + l_idx.to(torch.int64)
        sorted_keys, sorted_indices = torch.sort(keys)
        keep = sorted_indices[:max_pairs]
        b_idx = b_idx[keep]
        w_idx = w_idx[keep]
        l_idx = l_idx[keep]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'objective_order_pairs_strict_fixed_nonempty_v2_repaired_tagged', 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_band = int(extra.get('max_band', 3))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.1))

    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)
    # Anchor index (winner)
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :]  # (1, N)
    # Loser indices in a band ahead of winner (winner < loser <= winner + max_band)
    loser_range = winner_idx + torch.arange(1, max_band + 1, device=objective.device).view(-1, 1)  # (max_band, N)
    loser_range = loser_range.clamp(max=N-1)

    # Broadcast batch dimension
    winner_idx = winner_idx.expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    loser_range = loser_range.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Gather objective values
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx)  # (B, N)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_range.view(B, -1))  # (B, max_band*N)

    # Reshape to (B, max_band, N)
    obj_l = obj_l.view(B, max_band, N)

    # Compute mask for pairs where objective gap exceeds min_gap
    gap = obj_l - obj_w.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, max_band, N)
    mask = (gap >= min_gap)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Get nonzero pair indices
    b_idx, band_idx, w_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Determine loser indices from loser_range
    loser_idx = loser_range[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]

    # Compute weights as exponential decay of gap
    weight = torch.exp(-gap[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx])

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    advantage = feature_cache.get('advantage', objective.new_zeros(objective.shape))  # (B, N)
    device = objective.device

    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=device)  # (N,)

    # Expand indices for pairs
    winner_idx = idxs.unsqueeze(0).expand(N, N)  # (N, N)
    loser_idx = idxs.unsqueeze(1).expand(N, N)   # (N, N)

    # Compute advantage difference for all pairs per batch
    adv_w = advantage.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, N)  # (B, N, N)
    adv_l = advantage.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, N, N)  # (B, N, N)
    adv_diff = adv_w - adv_l  # (B, N, N)

    # Mask: positive advantage difference and exclude self-pairs
    pair_mask = (adv_diff > 0) & (winner_idx.unsqueeze(0) != loser_idx.unsqueeze(0))  # (B, N, N)

    # Get indices of valid pairs
    b_idx, w_idx, l_idx = pair_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    weights = adv_diff[b_idx, w_idx, l_idx]

    # If no pairs found, add fallback pairs: for each batch, pair idx 0 as winner vs idx 1 as loser with small positive weight
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        if N > 1:
            b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
            w_idx = torch.zeros(B, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
            l_idx = torch.ones(B, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
            weights = objective.new_full((B,), 1e-4)
        else:
            # If only one item per batch, cannot form pairs; return empty PrefBatch
            empty_idx = torch.empty((0,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
            return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty_idx, empty_idx, empty_idx), weight=objective.new_empty((0,)))

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx.to(torch.int64), w_idx.to(torch.int64), l_idx.to(torch.int64)), weight=weights)

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_band = int(extra.get('max_band', 3))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.1))

    device = objective.device
    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=device)  # (N,)

    # winner indices: (1, N)
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :]  # (1, N)
    # loser offsets: (max_band, 1)
    loser_offsets = torch.arange(1, max_band + 1, device=device).view(-1, 1)  # (max_band, 1)
    # loser indices: (max_band, N)
    loser_idx = winner_idx + loser_offsets  # (max_band, N)

    # Create mask for valid loser indices (loser_idx < N)
    valid_mask = loser_idx < N  # (max_band, N)
    # Clamp invalid loser indices to zero for safe gather
    safe_loser_idx = torch.where(valid_mask, loser_idx, torch.zeros_like(loser_idx))  # (max_band, N)

    # Expand for batch
    winner_idx_exp = winner_idx.expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    loser_idx_exp = safe_loser_idx.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)
    valid_mask_exp = valid_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Gather objective values
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)  # (B, N)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1))  # (B, max_band*N)
    obj_l = obj_l.view(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Compute gap and conditions
    gap = obj_l - obj_w.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, max_band, N)
    cond = (obj_w.unsqueeze(1) < obj_l) & (gap >= min_gap) & valid_mask_exp  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Get indices of valid pairs
    b_idx, band_idx, w_idx = cond.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # If no valid pairs, return empty PrefBatch
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
                      torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
                      torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)),
            weight=torch.empty(0, device=device),
            meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_expdecay_gapweight_simple_fixed_v2', 'max_band': max_band, 'gap_threshold': min_gap}
        )

    # Gather final winner and loser indices
    winner_final_idx = w_idx  # winner indices in N dimension
    loser_final_idx = loser_idx_exp[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]  # corresponding loser indices

    # Compute weights as exponential decay of gap
    gap_valid = gap[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]
    weights = torch.exp(-gap_valid)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx.long(), winner_final_idx.long(), loser_final_idx.long()),
        weight=weights,
        meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_expdecay_gapweight_simple_fixed_v2', 'max_band': max_band, 'gap_threshold': min_gap}
    )

    max_band = int(extra.get('max_band', 5))

    # Anchor index (winner)
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :]  # shape (1, n)
    # Loser indices within max_band ahead of winner
    loser_range = winner_idx + torch.arange(1, max_band + 1, device=objective.device).view(-1, 1)  # shape (max_band, n)
    loser_range = loser_range.clamp(max=n-1)

    # Expand batch dimension
    winner_idx = winner_idx.expand(batch_size, n)  # (B, n)
    loser_range = loser_range.unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, -1, -1)  # (B, max_band, n)

    # Gather objective values for winner and loser candidates
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx)  # (B, n)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_range.view(batch_size, -1))  # (B, max_band * n)
    obj_l = obj_l.view(batch_size, max_band, n)  # (B, max_band, n)

    # Mask pairs where loser objective exceeds winner by at least min_gap
    mask = (obj_w.unsqueeze(1) < obj_l) & ((obj_l - obj_w.unsqueeze(1)) >= min_gap)  # (B, max_band, n)

    # Get indices for valid pairs
    b_idx, band_idx, w_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Final winner and loser indices
    winner_idx_final = w_idx
    loser_idx_final = loser_range[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]

        loser_idx_final = loser_idx_final[keep_idx]

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # Generate all pairs
    mask_all = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx_all, winner_idx_all, loser_idx_all = mask_all.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # Generate sampled pairs based on gap threshold
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]
    thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.1))
    mask_gap = gap > thr
    b_idx_gap, winner_idx_gap, loser_idx_gap = mask_gap.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # Combine pairs: prioritize significant pairs, fill with all pairs if needed
    total_pairs = b_idx_gap.numel()
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    if total_pairs < max_pairs:
        # Fill remaining with all pairs
        remaining = max_pairs - total_pairs
        indices = torch.randperm(b_idx_all.numel(), device=b_idx_all.device)[:remaining]
        b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx_gap, b_idx_all[indices]])
        winner_idx = torch.cat([winner_idx_gap, winner_idx_all[indices]])
        loser_idx = torch.cat([loser_idx_gap, loser_idx_all[indices]])
    else:
        # Use only significant pairs
        topk = torch.topk(gap[b_idx_gap, winner_idx_gap, loser_idx_gap], k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx_gap[topk]
        winner_idx = winner_idx_gap[topk]
        loser_idx = loser_idx_gap[topk]
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'robust_combined'})

    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    device = objective.device
    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=device)  # (N,)

    # For each winner index, construct loser candidates at offsets spaced by sample_stride in [min_gap, max_gap]
    gap_offsets = torch.arange(min_gap, max_gap + 1, sample_stride, device=device).long()  # (num_offsets,)
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :]  # (1, N)
    loser_idx = winner_idx + gap_offsets[:, None]  # (num_offsets, N)

    # Mask invalid loser indices
    valid_mask = loser_idx < N
    safe_loser_idx = torch.where(valid_mask, loser_idx, torch.zeros_like(loser_idx))  # safe for gather

    # Expand batch dim
    winner_idx_exp = winner_idx.expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    loser_idx_exp = safe_loser_idx.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, num_offsets, N)
    valid_mask_exp = valid_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, num_offsets, N)

    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1)).view(B, loser_idx_exp.size(1), N)  # (B, num_offsets, N)

    lp_l = log_prob.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1)).view(B, loser_idx_exp.size(1), N)  # (B, num_offsets, N)

    loser_final_idx = loser_idx_exp[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]

    weight = torch.exp(-topk_gap[valid_topk_mask])  # (num_pairs,)

    loser_idx_exp = safe_loser_idx.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)
    valid_mask_exp = valid_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Gather objectives
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)  # (B, N)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1))  # (B, max_band*N)
    obj_l = obj_l.view(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Compute gap
    gap = obj_l - obj_w.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Initial condition mask for winner < loser and gap >= threshold
    cond = (obj_w.unsqueeze(1) < obj_l) & (gap >= min_gap) & valid_mask_exp  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Compute weights with exponential decay on absolute gap
    weights = torch.exp(-gap.abs()) * cond.float()  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Flatten weights for topk selection
    weights_flat = weights.view(B, -1)  # (B, max_band*N)
    k = min(max_pairs, weights_flat.shape[1])
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weights_flat, k=k, dim=1)

    # Convert flat indices to band and offset indices
    band_idx = topk_idx // N  # (B, k)
    offset_idx = topk_idx % N  # (B, k)

    # Gather winner and loser indices
    winner_indices = offset_idx  # (B, k)
    safe_loser_idx_flat = safe_loser_idx.view(-1)  # (max_band*N,)
    loser_indices = safe_loser_idx_flat[band_idx * N + offset_idx]  # (B, k)

    # Gather objectives for selected pairs to double-check semantics
    obj_w_sel = objective[torch.arange(B, device=device).unsqueeze(1), winner_indices]  # (B, k)
    obj_l_sel = objective[torch.arange(B, device=device).unsqueeze(1), loser_indices]   # (B, k)

    # Keep only pairs with strict winner < loser objective
    valid_pairs_mask = (obj_w_sel < obj_l_sel)

    # Apply mask
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, k)  # (B, k)
    b_idx = b_idx[valid_pairs_mask]  # (num_valid,)
    winner_indices = winner_indices[valid_pairs_mask]  # (num_valid,)
    loser_indices = loser_indices[valid_pairs_mask]  # (num_valid,)
    pair_weights = topk_vals[valid_pairs_mask]  # (num_valid,)

    # Return PrefBatch
    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx.to(torch.int64), winner_indices.to(torch.int64), loser_indices.to(torch.int64)),
        weight=pair_weights,
        meta={'builder': 'rank_band_expdecay_gapweight_fixed_v4', 'max_band': max_band, 'max_pairs': k}
    )

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device
    # Create all pairs where winner objective < loser objective
    mask_all = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx_all, winner_idx_all, loser_idx_all = mask_all.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # Compute gap
    gap = objective[b_idx_all, loser_idx_all] - objective[b_idx_all, winner_idx_all]
    # Clamp gap to cap value
    cap = float(extra.get('gap_cap', 1.0))
    gap_clamped = gap.clamp(max=cap)
    # Filter pairs by threshold
    thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.1))
    valid_mask = gap_clamped > thr
    b_idx = b_idx_all[valid_mask]
    winner_idx = winner_idx_all[valid_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx_all[valid_mask]
    gap_clamped = gap_clamped[valid_mask]
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    # If too many pairs, select top max_pairs by clamped gap
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_indices = gap_clamped.topk(k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_indices]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_indices]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_indices]
    # Return pairwise PrefBatch
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'robust_pairwise_clamp_cap'})

Returns batch indices along with winner and loser indices to comply with PrefBatch requirements, masking invalid loser indices to avoid indexing errors.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_band = int(extra.get('max_band', 3))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.1))
    decay_rate = float(extra.get('decay_rate', 0.5))

    device = objective.device
    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=device)  # (N,)

    # winner indices shape (1, N)
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :]  # (1, N)
    # loser offsets shape (max_band, 1)
    loser_offsets = torch.arange(1, max_band + 1, device=device).view(-1, 1)  # (max_band, 1)
    # loser indices shape (max_band, N)
    loser_idx = winner_idx + loser_offsets  # (max_band, N)

    # Mask for valid loser indices
    valid_mask = loser_idx < N  # (max_band, N)
    # Clamp invalid loser indices to zero for safe gather
    safe_loser_idx = torch.where(valid_mask, loser_idx, torch.zeros_like(loser_idx))  # (max_band, N)

    # Expand indices for batch
    winner_idx_exp = winner_idx.expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    loser_idx_exp = safe_loser_idx.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)
    valid_mask_exp = valid_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Batch indices for pairs
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).view(B, 1, 1).expand(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Gather objective values
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)  # (B, N)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1))  # (B, max_band*N)
    obj_l = obj_l.view(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Compute gap and conditions
    gap = obj_l - obj_w.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, max_band, N)
    cond = (obj_w.unsqueeze(1) < obj_l) & (gap >= min_gap) & valid_mask_exp  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Compute decay weights
    weights = torch.exp(-decay_rate * gap) * cond.to(gap.dtype)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Flatten batch and pairs
    b_idx_flat = b_idx.reshape(-1)  # (B*max_band*N,)
    pair_w_idx = winner_idx_exp.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, max_band, N).reshape(-1)  # (B*max_band*N,)
    pair_l_idx = loser_idx_exp.reshape(-1)  # (B*max_band*N,)
    weights_flat = weights.reshape(-1)  # (B*max_band*N,)

    # Filter valid pairs
    valid_pairs = weights_flat > 0
    b_idx_flat = b_idx_flat[valid_pairs].long()  # (num_pairs,)
    pair_w_idx = pair_w_idx[valid_pairs].long()  # (num_pairs,)
    pair_l_idx = pair_l_idx[valid_pairs].long()  # (num_pairs,)
    weights_final = weights_flat[valid_pairs]

    # Return PrefBatch with batch indices
    pairs = (b_idx_flat, pair_w_idx, pair_l_idx)  # tuple of (b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=pairs,
        weight=weights_final,
        meta={'family': 'anchor_vs_band_simple_gap_weight_fixed_fixedidx'}
    )

ir.name: sparse_disagreement_topgap_vectorweight
ir.intuition: Pairs formed by selecting winners and losers separated by a top-gap offset, focusing on pairs with highest disagreement in prediction, weighted by normalized vectorized disagreement magnitude with soft exponential scaling.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    top_gap = int(extra.get('top_gap', 5))  # fixed gap offset
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    disagreement_threshold = float(extra.get('disagreement_threshold', 0.05))
    soft_exp_scale = float(extra.get('soft_exp_scale', 5.0))
    device = objective.device

    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :-top_gap]  # winners exclude last top_gap indices, shape (1, N-top_gap)
    loser_idx = winner_idx + top_gap  # losers are top_gap ahead

    winner_idx_exp = winner_idx.expand(B, -1)  # (B, N-top_gap)
    loser_idx_exp = loser_idx.expand(B, -1)    # (B, N-top_gap)

    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)  # (B, N-top_gap)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_idx_exp)   # (B, N-top_gap)

    lp_w = log_prob.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)   # (B, N-top_gap)
    lp_l = log_prob.gather(1, loser_idx_exp)    # (B, N-top_gap)

    valid_mask = obj_w < obj_l  # (B, N-top_gap), winner strictly better

    disagreement = (lp_w - lp_l).abs() * valid_mask.float()  # zero out invalid

    # Filter by disagreement threshold
    disc_mask = disagreement >= disagreement_threshold

    b_idx, pair_pos = disc_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = torch.tensor([], device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'sparse_disagreement_topgap_vectorweight'})

    w_idx = winner_idx_exp[b_idx, pair_pos]
    l_idx = loser_idx_exp[b_idx, pair_pos]

    disc_vals = disagreement[b_idx, pair_pos]
    # Normalize disagreement by max disagreement per batch
    max_disc_per_b = torch.zeros(B, device=device).scatter_reduce_(0, b_idx, disc_vals, reduce='amax', include_self=False)
    max_disc_per_b = torch.clamp(max_disc_per_b, min=1e-8)
    norm_disc_vals = disc_vals / max_disc_per_b[b_idx]

    # Apply soft exponential weighting: weight = 1 - exp(-scale * norm_disc)
    weights = 1.0 - torch.exp(-soft_exp_scale * norm_disc_vals)

    # Cap weights softly at 1.0
    weights = torch.clamp(weights, max=1.0)

    # Select top max_pairs by weights
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weights, max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        w_idx = w_idx[topk_idx]
        l_idx = l_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'sparse_disagreement_topgap_vectorweight', 'top_gap': top_gap, 'disagreement_threshold': disagreement_threshold, 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'soft_exp_scale': soft_exp_scale})

ir.intuition: Constructs pairwise preferences by anchoring winners with losers at sparse offsets in a fixed rank band, selecting pairs where the winner's objective is strictly better and disagreement in log probabilities exceeds a threshold. Uses vectorized masking and stable indexing with top-k to cap pairs and avoid shape mismatches.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    max_band = int(extra.get('max_band', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    disagreement_threshold = float(extra.get('disagreement_threshold', 0.1))

    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=device)  # (N,)
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :]  # (1, N)

    # Sparse band offsets: odd offsets 1,3,5,... up to max_band
    band_offsets = torch.arange(1, max_band + 1, 2, device=device)  # (num_offsets,)
    num_offsets = band_offsets.shape[0]

    # Loser indices shape: (num_offsets, N)
    loser_idx = winner_idx + band_offsets.view(-1, 1)  # (num_offsets, N)
    valid_mask = loser_idx < N  # (num_offsets, N)
    # For invalid indices, set to zero (safe dummy index)
    safe_loser_idx = torch.where(valid_mask, loser_idx, torch.zeros_like(loser_idx))

    # Expand to batch dimension:
    winner_idx_exp = winner_idx.expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    loser_idx_exp = safe_loser_idx.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, num_offsets, N)  # (B, num_offsets, N)
    valid_mask_exp = valid_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, num_offsets, N)  # (B, num_offsets, N)

    # Gather objectives and log_probs:
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)  # (B, N)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1)).view(B, num_offsets, N)  # (B, num_offsets, N)
    lp_w = log_prob.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)  # (B, N)
    lp_l = log_prob.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1)).view(B, num_offsets, N)  # (B, num_offsets, N)

    # Condition: winner objective < loser objective
    better_mask = obj_w.unsqueeze(1) < obj_l  # (B, num_offsets, N)
    # Disagreement in log_prob abs difference
    disagreement = (lp_w.unsqueeze(1) - lp_l).abs()  # (B, num_offsets, N)

    # Valid pairs mask
    valid_pairs_mask = better_mask & (disagreement >= disagreement_threshold) & valid_mask_exp  # (B, num_offsets, N)

    b_idx, band_idx, w_idx = valid_pairs_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = torch.tensor([], device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_anchor_rankband_simple'})

    # Gather winner and loser indices for valid pairs
    winner_final_idx = w_idx  # winner indices in [0, N)
    loser_final_idx = loser_idx_exp[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]  # corresponding loser indices

    pair_weights = disagreement[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]

    # Cap to max_pairs by top-k on pair_weights
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_indices = torch.topk(pair_weights, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_indices]
        winner_final_idx = winner_final_idx[topk_indices]
        loser_final_idx = loser_final_idx[topk_indices]
        pair_weights = pair_weights[topk_indices]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx.to(torch.int64), winner_final_idx.to(torch.int64), loser_final_idx.to(torch.int64)),
        weight=pair_weights,
        meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_anchor_rankband_simple', 'max_band': max_band, 'disagreement_threshold': disagreement_threshold, 'max_pairs': max_pairs}
    )

    B, N = objective.shape
    min_gap = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.1))

    device = objective.device
    if N < 2:

        pair_idx = (torch.empty((0,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
                    torch.empty((0,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
                    torch.empty((0,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device))
        weights = torch.empty((0,), device=device)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weights, meta={})

    # Indices for consecutive pairs
    winner_idx = torch.arange(N - 1, device=device)  # (N-1,)
    loser_idx = winner_idx + 1  # (N-1,)

    # Expand for batch
    batch_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, N - 1)  # (B, N-1)
    winner_idx_exp = winner_idx.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, N - 1)  # (B, N-1)
    loser_idx_exp = loser_idx.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, N - 1)  # (B, N-1)

    # Gather objectives
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)  # (B, N-1)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_idx_exp)   # (B, N-1)

    # Compute gap
    gap = obj_l - obj_w  # (B, N-1)

    # Condition: winner objective < loser objective and gap >= min_gap
    valid_mask = (obj_w < obj_l) & (gap >= min_gap)  # (B, N-1)

    # Extract valid pairs
    b_idx, p_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_final_idx = winner_idx_exp[b_idx, p_idx]
    loser_final_idx = loser_idx_exp[b_idx, p_idx]

    pair_idx = (b_idx.to(torch.int64), winner_final_idx.to(torch.int64), loser_final_idx.to(torch.int64))

    # Assign uniform weights
    weights = torch.ones(pair_idx[0].shape[0], device=device)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weights, meta={})

ir.name: objective_order_pairs_strict_fixed_nonempty_v3
ir.intuition: Enhanced strictness in pair selection by adjusting thresholds to favor more informative pairs while maintaining non-emptiness. The thresholds are tuned to balance strict inequality and include equal objective pairs when no strict pairs are available, with caps to prevent excessive pairs. Constants are configurable via 'extra' to allow flexible tuning.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.15))  # Slightly increased threshold
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 256))  # Increased cap for more pairs

    device = objective.device
    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=device)

    winner_idx = idxs.view(1, -1)  # (1, N)
    loser_idx = idxs.view(-1, 1)  # (N, 1)

    valid_pairs = winner_idx < loser_idx  # (N, N)
    valid_pairs = valid_pairs.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, N, N)

    obj_w = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    obj_l = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)

    # Strict winner objective < loser objective
    strict_mask = obj_w < obj_l  # (B, N, N)
    pair_mask = valid_pairs & strict_mask  # (B, N, N)

    b_idx_s, w_idx_s, l_idx_s = pair_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    strict_counts = torch.bincount(b_idx_s, minlength=B) if b_idx_s.numel() > 0 else torch.zeros(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)
    no_strict_batches = (strict_counts == 0).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]

    if no_strict_batches.numel() > 0:
        equal_mask = valid_pairs & (obj_w == obj_l)  # (B, N, N)
        b_idx_e, w_idx_e, l_idx_e = equal_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

        batch_mask = torch.zeros(B, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device)
        batch_mask[no_strict_batches] = True
        keep_eq_mask = batch_mask[b_idx_e]

        b_idx_e = b_idx_e[keep_eq_mask]
        w_idx_e = w_idx_e[keep_eq_mask]
        l_idx_e = l_idx_e[keep_eq_mask]

        if b_idx_s.numel() > 0:
            b_idx = torch.cat([b_idx_s, b_idx_e], dim=0)
            w_idx = torch.cat([w_idx_s, w_idx_e], dim=0)
            l_idx = torch.cat([l_idx_s, l_idx_e], dim=0)
        else:
            b_idx, w_idx, l_idx = b_idx_e, w_idx_e, l_idx_e
    else:
        b_idx, w_idx, l_idx = b_idx_s, w_idx_s, l_idx_s

    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        if N > 1:
            b_idx = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.long, device=objective.device)
            w_idx = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.long, device=objective.device)
            l_idx = torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.long, device=objective.device)
        else:
            empty = torch.tensor([], dtype=torch.long, device=objective.device)
            return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'objective_order_pairs_strict_fixed_nonempty_v3', 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        keys = b_idx.to(torch.int64) * (N**2) + w_idx.to(torch.int64) * N + l_idx.to(torch.int64)
        sorted_keys, sorted_indices = torch.sort(keys)
        keep = sorted_indices[:max_pairs]
        b_idx = b_idx[keep]
        w_idx = w_idx[keep]
        l_idx = l_idx[keep]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'objective_order_pairs_strict_fixed_nonempty_v3', 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_band = int(extra.get('max_band', 4))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.2))
    weight_cap = float(extra.get('weight_cap', 0.5))

    device = objective.device
    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :]  # (1, N)
    loser_offsets = torch.arange(1, max_band + 1, device=device).view(-1, 1)  # (max_band, 1)
    loser_idx = winner_idx + loser_offsets  # (max_band, N)
    valid_mask = loser_idx < N  # (max_band, N)
    safe_loser_idx = torch.where(valid_mask, loser_idx, torch.zeros_like(loser_idx))

    # Expand for batch
    winner_idx_exp = winner_idx.expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    loser_idx_exp = safe_loser_idx.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)
    valid_mask_exp = valid_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Gather objectives
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)  # (B, N)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1))  # (B, max_band * N)
    obj_l = obj_l.view(B, max_band, N)

    # Compute gap and conditions
    gap = obj_l - obj_w.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, max_band, N)
    sign_diff = torch.sign(gap)
    disagreement_mask = (sign_diff == 1) & (gap >= min_gap) & valid_mask_exp

    b_idx, band_idx, w_idx = disagreement_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
                      torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
                      torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)),
            weight=torch.empty(0, device=device),
            meta={'builder': 'robust_anchor_topk', 'max_band': max_band, 'gap_threshold': min_gap}
        )
    winner_final_idx = w_idx
    loser_final_idx = loser_idx_exp[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]
    gaps_selected = gap[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]
    weights = torch.exp(-gaps_selected).clamp(max=1.0)
    if b_idx.numel() > int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128)):
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(gaps_selected, k=int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128)), largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_final_idx = winner_final_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_final_idx = loser_final_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = weights[topk_idx]
    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx.long(), winner_final_idx.long(), loser_final_idx.long()),
        weight=weights,
        meta={'builder': 'robust_anchor_topk', 'max_band': max_band, 'gap_threshold': min_gap, 'max_pairs': int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))}
    )

ir.intuition: Pairs winners with losers in a sparse rank gap ahead focusing on pairs with highest model prediction disagreement, weighting pairs by normalized disagreement magnitude with a hard cap to emphasize uncertain informative pairs while controlling pair count.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_gap = int(extra.get('max_gap', 8))
    min_gap = int(extra.get('min_gap', 3))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    disagreement_threshold = float(extra.get('disagreement_threshold', 0.05))
    weight_cap = float(extra.get('weight_cap', 1.0))

    device = objective.device
    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=device)  # (N,)
    # Sparse loser indices: select losers at ranks with gaps from min_gap to max_gap stepping by 2
    gap_offsets = torch.arange(min_gap, max_gap + 1, 2, device=device)  # e.g. 3,5,7
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :]  # (1, N)
    loser_idx = winner_idx + gap_offsets[:, None]  # (num_offsets, N)
    valid_mask = loser_idx < N
    safe_loser_idx = torch.where(valid_mask, loser_idx, torch.zeros_like(loser_idx))

    # Expand for batch
    winner_idx_exp = winner_idx.expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    loser_idx_exp = safe_loser_idx.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, gap_offsets.shape[0], N)  # (B, num_offsets, N)
    valid_mask_exp = valid_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, gap_offsets.shape[0], N)

    # Gather objectives and log_probs
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)  # (B, N)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1)).view(B, gap_offsets.shape[0], N)  # (B, num_offsets, N)
    lp_w = log_prob.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)  # (B, N)
    lp_l = log_prob.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1)).view(B, gap_offsets.shape[0], N)  # (B, num_offsets, N)

    # Conditions: winner objective < loser objective
    valid_obj_mask = (obj_w.unsqueeze(1) < obj_l) & valid_mask_exp

    # Compute disagreement
    disagreement = (lp_w.unsqueeze(1) - lp_l).abs() * valid_obj_mask.float()
    disc_mask = disagreement >= disagreement_threshold

    b_idx, band_idx, w_idx = disc_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = torch.tensor([], device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'rank_gap_sparse_disagreement_weighted'})

    winner_final_idx = w_idx
    loser_final_idx = loser_idx_exp[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]

    pair_disagreement = disagreement[b_idx, band_idx, w_idx]

    # Normalize weights within each batch
    max_disc_per_batch = torch.zeros(B, device=device)
    max_disc_per_batch.index_put_((b_idx,), pair_disagreement, accumulate=True)
    max_disc = torch.zeros_like(max_disc_per_batch)
    max_disc.index_add_(0, b_idx, pair_disagreement)
    max_disc = torch.zeros_like(max_disc_per_batch).scatter_reduce(0, b_idx, pair_disagreement, reduce='amax', include_self=False)
    max_disc = max_disc.clamp(min=1e-8)
    norm_weights = pair_disagreement / max_disc[b_idx]

    # Cap weights
    norm_weights = norm_weights.clamp(max=weight_cap)

    # Cap total pairs by max_pairs
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        keep_idx = torch.topk(norm_weights, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False).indices
        b_idx = b_idx[keep_idx]
        winner_final_idx = winner_final_idx[keep_idx]
        loser_final_idx = loser_final_idx[keep_idx]
        norm_weights = norm_weights[keep_idx]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_final_idx, loser_final_idx),
        weight=norm_weights,
        meta={
            'builder': 'rank_gap_sparse_disagreement_weighted',
            'max_gap': max_gap,
            'min_gap': min_gap,
            'disagreement_threshold': disagreement_threshold,
            'weight_cap': weight_cap,
            'max_pairs': max_pairs
        }
    )

    # Loser indices: (max_band, N)

    valid_mask = loser_idx < N  # (max_band, N)
    safe_loser_idx = torch.where(valid_mask, loser_idx, torch.zeros_like(loser_idx))  # (max_band, N)

    # Expand for batch
    winner_idx_exp = winner_idx.expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    loser_idx_exp = safe_loser_idx.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)
    valid_mask_exp = valid_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)

    obj_l = obj_l.view(B, max_band, N)  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Compute gap: winner better means objective lower (lower_is_better)
    gap = obj_l - obj_w.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, max_band, N)
    condition = (obj_w.unsqueeze(1) < obj_l) & (gap >= min_gap) & valid_mask_exp  # (B, max_band, N)

    # Get valid pairs indices
    b_idx, band_idx, w_idx = condition.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        # If no pairs, forcibly create at least one trivial pair (first batch, first two indices if possible)
        if N > 1:
            b_idx = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
            w_idx = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
            loser_final_idx = torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)

    pair_idx = (b_idx.to(torch.int64), w_idx.to(torch.int64), loser_final_idx.to(torch.int64))

ir.intuition: Pairs are formed by anchoring on top-ranked items and pairing only with items where there is maximal disagreement between model predictions (log_prob), introducing sparse, disagreement-driven pairing with uniform weights and a novel cap.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device
    max_anchors = int(extra.get('max_anchors', 5))
    disagreement_thresh = float(extra.get('disagreement_threshold', 0.2))
    cap_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    # Identify top-k anchors per batch by best objective (lowest values)
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(objective, k=min(max_anchors, N), largest=False, sorted=True)
    # topk_idx shape: (B, max_anchors)

    # Expand anchors and candidate indices to compare
    anchors_exp = topk_idx.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, max_anchors, N)  # (B, max_anchors, N)
    candidates = torch.arange(N, device=device).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, max_anchors, N)  # (B, max_anchors, N)

    # Mask out anchors themselves in candidate set
    candidate_mask = candidates != anchors_exp

    # Gather log_prob for anchors and candidates
    anchor_logp = log_prob.gather(1, anchors_exp.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, max_anchors, N)  # (B, max_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, max_anchors, N)  # (B, max_anchors, N)

    # Compute absolute disagreement between anchor and candidate log_probs
    disagreement = torch.abs(anchor_logp - candidate_logp)  # (B, max_anchors, N)

    # Select pairs where disagreement exceeds threshold and candidate objective is worse (higher) than anchor
    candidate_obj = objective.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, max_anchors, N)  # (B, max_anchors, N)
    anchor_obj = objective.gather(1, anchors_exp.reshape(B, -1)).reshape(B, max_anchors, N)  # (B, max_anchors, N)

    valid_pairs_mask = (disagreement >= disagreement_thresh) & (candidate_obj > anchor_obj) & candidate_mask

    b_idx, anchor_pos, cand_idx = valid_pairs_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchors_exp[b_idx, anchor_pos, cand_idx]  # anchor indices
    loser_idx = cand_idx  # candidate indices

    # Uniform weights
    weights = torch.ones_like(b_idx, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)

    # Cap pairs to max allowed
    if b_idx.numel() > cap_pairs:
        weights_sorted, indices = torch.topk(weights, k=cap_pairs)
        b_idx = b_idx[indices]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[indices]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[indices]
        weights = weights_sorted

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=weights,
        meta={
            'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_anchor_pairs',
            'max_anchors': max_anchors,
            'disagreement_threshold': disagreement_thresh,
            'max_pairs': cap_pairs
        }
    )

    # For each offset in band, create loser indices
    loser_offsets = torch.arange(1, max_band + 1, device=device).view(-1, 1)  # (max_band, 1)
    loser_idx = winner_idx + loser_offsets  # (max_band, N - max_band)

    # Expand for batch
    winner_idx_exp = winner_idx.expand(B, -1)  # (B, N - max_band)
    loser_idx_exp = loser_idx.expand(B, -1, -1)  # (B, max_band, N - max_band)

    # Gather objective values
    obj_w = objective.gather(1, winner_idx_exp)  # (B, N - max_band)
    # Reshape for band dimension
    obj_w_exp = obj_w.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, max_band, -1)  # (B, max_band, N - max_band)

    obj_l = objective.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1)).view(B, max_band, -1)  # (B, max_band, N - max_band)

    # Gather log_prob values
    lp_w = log_prob.gather(1, winner_idx_exp).unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, max_band, -1)  # (B, max_band, N - max_band)
    lp_l = log_prob.gather(1, loser_idx_exp.reshape(B, -1)).view(B, max_band, -1)  # (B, max_band, N - max_band)

    # Valid pairs: winner objective < loser objective
    valid_mask = obj_w_exp < obj_l

    # Disagreement magnitude
    disagreement = (lp_w - lp_l).abs() * valid_mask.float()

    # Filter by disagreement threshold
    disc_mask = disagreement >= disagreement_threshold

    b_idx, band_idx, pair_pos = disc_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = torch.tensor([], device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_disagreement_weighted'})

    w_idx = winner_idx_exp[b_idx, pair_pos]
    l_idx = loser_idx_exp[b_idx, band_idx, pair_pos]

    disc_vals = disagreement[b_idx, band_idx, pair_pos]

    # Normalize disagreement per batch
    max_disc_per_b = torch.zeros(B, device=device).scatter_reduce_(0, b_idx, disc_vals, reduce='amax', include_self=False)
    max_disc_per_b = torch.clamp(max_disc_per_b, min=1e-8)
    norm_disc = disc_vals / max_disc_per_b[b_idx]

    # Linear weighting: weight = norm_disc scaled to weight_cap
    weights = norm_disc * weight_cap
    weights = torch.clamp(weights, max=weight_cap)

    # Cap number of pairs
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weights, max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        w_idx = w_idx[topk_idx]
        l_idx = l_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, w_idx, l_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_disagreement_weighted', 'max_band': max_band, 'disagreement_threshold': disagreement_threshold, 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'weight_cap': weight_cap})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device
    neighborhood_radius = int(extra.get('neighborhood_radius', 3))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.1))
    weight_cap = float(extra.get('weight_cap', 0.7))

    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=device)

    # For each item i, consider neighbors j in [i - neighborhood_radius, i + neighborhood_radius], excluding i
    neighbor_offsets = torch.cat([torch.arange(-neighborhood_radius, 0, device=device), torch.arange(1, neighborhood_radius + 1, device=device)])  # (2*radius,)
    neighbors = idxs.unsqueeze(0) + neighbor_offsets.unsqueeze(1)  # (2*radius, N)
    valid_mask = (neighbors >= 0) & (neighbors < N)
    safe_neighbors = torch.where(valid_mask, neighbors, torch.zeros_like(neighbors))

    # Expand for batch
    item_idx_exp = idxs.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, N)  # (B, N)
    neighbors_exp = safe_neighbors.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, neighbor_offsets.size(0), N)  # (B, 2*radius, N)
    valid_mask_exp = valid_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, neighbor_offsets.size(0), N)

    # Gather objective values
    obj_i = objective.gather(1, item_idx_exp)  # (B, N)
    obj_j = objective.gather(1, neighbors_exp.reshape(B, -1))  # (B, 2*radius * N)
    obj_j = obj_j.view(B, neighbor_offsets.size(0), N)  # (B, 2*radius, N)

    # Compute sign of differences for item i vs neighbors j
    diff = obj_j - obj_i.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 2*radius, N)
    sign_diff = diff.sign()  # -1, 0, or 1

    # Look for sign flips between neighbors: pairs where sign of difference flips compared to previous neighbor
    # For each neighbor offset except the first, compare sign_diff[:, k, :] to sign_diff[:, k-1, :]
    if neighbor_offsets.size(0) < 2:
        # If radius=1, no sign flip possible; return empty
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
                                                   torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
                                                   torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.long, device=device)),
                         weight=torch.empty(0, device=device), meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_neigh_gapclamp'})

    sign_flip_mask = (sign_diff[:, 1:, :] * sign_diff[:, :-1, :] < 0) & valid_mask_exp[:, 1:, :] & valid_mask_exp[:, :-1, :]

    # For pairs where sign flips, take the two neighbors involved and create pairs (winner, loser) accordingly
    # We form pairs between item i and the neighbor j where sign flip detected
    b_idx, offset_idx, i_idx = sign_flip_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Determine pairs: for each detected flip, pick the neighbor index involved (offset_idx or offset_idx+1)
    # Use offset_idx+1 neighbors as losers and offset_idx neighbors as winners or vice versa depending on gap
    neighbor1_idx = neighbors_exp[b_idx, offset_idx, i_idx]
    neighbor2_idx = neighbors_exp[b_idx, offset_idx + 1, i_idx]

    # Compute gaps for these pairs
    val1 = objective[b_idx, neighbor1_idx]
    val2 = objective[b_idx, neighbor2_idx]

    # Select winner as the lower objective, loser as higher objective
    winner_idx = torch.where(val1 < val2, neighbor1_idx, neighbor2_idx)
    loser_idx = torch.where(val1 < val2, neighbor2_idx, neighbor1_idx)

    # Compute gap values for weighting and filtering
    gap_values = objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]

    # Filter by min_gap
    valid_pairs_mask = gap_values >= min_gap
    b_idx = b_idx[valid_pairs_mask]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[valid_pairs_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[valid_pairs_mask]
    gap_values = gap_values[valid_pairs_mask]

    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
                                                   torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
                                                   torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.long, device=device)),
                         weight=torch.empty(0, device=device), meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_neigh_gapclamp'})

    # Compute weights as exp(-gap) clamped by weight_cap
    weights = torch.exp(-gap_values)
    weights = torch.clamp(weights, max=weight_cap)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx.long(), winner_idx.long(), loser_idx.long()), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_neigh_gapclamp', 'neighborhood_radius': neighborhood_radius, 'gap_threshold': min_gap, 'weight_cap': weight_cap})

ir.name: disagreement_sparse_rankgap_uniformweight
ir.intuition: Pairs anchor winners and select losers from sparse indices with large rank gaps, uniformly weighted to emphasize diverse rank separations without gap-based weighting.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    max_candidates = int(extra.get('max_candidates', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    min_gap = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.1))

    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)
    winner_idx = idxs[None, :].expand(B, N)  # (B, N)

    _, ranks = log_prob.argsort(dim=1, descending=True).sort(dim=1)  # ranks: (B, N)

    ranks_w = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    ranks_l = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    rank_disagreement = torch.abs(ranks_w - ranks_l)  # (B, N, N)

    # Select top max_candidates losers with largest rank disagreement per winner
    topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(rank_disagreement, k=max_candidates, dim=2, largest=True, sorted=False)  # (B, N, max_candidates)

    obj_w = objective.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, N, max_candidates)  # (B, N, max_candidates)
    obj_l = objective.gather(1, topk_idx.view(B, -1)).view(B, N, max_candidates)  # (B, N, max_candidates)

    valid_mask = (obj_w < obj_l) & ((obj_l - obj_w) >= min_gap)  # (B, N, max_candidates)

    b_idx, w_idx, c_idx = valid_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    loser_idx = topk_idx[b_idx, w_idx, c_idx]
    winner_idx_final = w_idx

    # Uniform weights (all ones)
    weights = None

    # Cap total pairs to max_pairs by random selection if needed
    total_pairs = b_idx.numel()
    if total_pairs > max_pairs:
        perm = torch.randperm(total_pairs, device=b_idx.device)[:max_pairs]
        b_idx = b_idx[perm]
        winner_idx_final = winner_idx_final[perm]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[perm]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx_final, loser_idx),
        weight=weights,
        meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_rankgap_uniformweight', 'max_candidates': max_candidates, 'gap_threshold': min_gap, 'max_pairs': max_pairs}
    )
